title: Optimization of compression ratio in LHR engine fueled with nano Al2O3-emulsified biodiesel using RSM and machine learning
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,51178-51197
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06361B, Paper

Radha Krishna Gopidesi, Kautkar Nitin Uttamrao, Channa Keshava Naik N., Premkartikkumar S R, Ahmed Adnan Hadi, K. Sunil Kumar, T. M. Yunus Khan, Abdul Saddique Shaik, Ahmed A. Alamiery
This study examines how varying compression ratios affect the performance and emissions of a fly ash-coated low heat rejection diesel engine fueled with a nano-Al2O3-based emulsified cottonseed biodiesel blend (B20W10Al200).
